messages.subject: combining javascript with shiny
parts:
Hi

I am new learner in shiny. I am using shiny web application with javascript for making some plots. The javascript I am using for the manipulation by mouseclicks. Is it possible to store the changes on plots by mouseclicks  in to a variable in R.
